requirement: Implement EPIC 1, Story 1: make the v1.1 in-memory pattern and Tone transport a single 64-step, eight-beat source of truth.

architecture.decision: Keep the Pattern as the sole 64-step event model and make transport import STEPS for every clock boundary.
alternatives: Retain separate 32-step UI/audio clocks and translate at their boundary.
Store a second timing representation alongside the pattern.
tradeoffs: A shared constant requires updating legacy 32-step assumptions now, but prevents pattern, playhead, and audio scheduling from drifting.
No serialization contract is added here; strict v3 import/export is owned by EPIC 2.
seams: src/pattern.ts owns STEPS and immutable event operations.
src/transport.ts is the sole clock and emits 0..63.
Existing consumers derive their dimensions from STEPS.

tasks.intent: Mark the selected priority-one story in progress and persist its implementation queue for safe resumption.
tasks.acceptance: Both trackers show Story 1 In progress and this plan identifies the verified task queue.

tasks.result: Marked EPIC 1 Story 1 In progress in both v1.1 trackers and saved this valid JSON execution plan.

tasks.title: Make pattern events a deterministic 64-step model
tasks.intent: Change the source-of-truth pattern helpers to 64 slots and enforce bounded, non-overlapping bass edits.
constraints: Do not add a second clock or free-time bass representation.
tasks.acceptance: Fresh drum and bass arrays have 64 entries; bass lengths clamp to 1..64; replacing a bass start deterministically removes conflicting starts; active cells resolve across the loop seam.
verify: node-based pure self-check harness for src/pattern.ts
tasks.result: Pattern now owns a 64-step immutable model with clamped, deterministic non-overlapping bass holds.

tasks.title: Bind the transport and timing consumers to 64 steps
tasks.intent: Ensure the Tone clock and pure timing defaults traverse 0..63 over the existing two-measure loop.
constraints: Keep click accents on beats 0 and 4.
tasks.acceptance: Step callbacks and current fractional position use the 64-step ring; pure checks cover 63 to 0; click accents remain at beats 0 and 4.
verify: node-based pure self-check harness for src/transport.ts and src/hit.ts
tasks.result: Transport and hit-window timing now derive from STEPS, schedule 32nd notes, and cover the 63-to-0 seam.

tasks.title: Verify the story and close its trackers
tasks.intent: Independently build and exercise the pure 64-step seams, then record completion.
constraints: Do not claim browser audio output without an available audio device.
tasks.acceptance: Build passes; pure checks prove the 64-step model and clock; both trackers show Story 1 Done with session notes.
tasks.visual: No new visual surface belongs to Story 1; Story 2 owns the rendered 64-step grid.
tasks.result: Production build and independent pure harnesses passed; both v1.1 trackers are marked Done.
evidence: clean-reload browser DOM check: 64 grid headers and step controls; no console errors
